extraction.Name: Mary Goriux, now Ecoffey
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want the patent in fee to her allotment, but took it because the Agent told her that if she did not, the land would be sold to pay the taxes
extraction.Buyer: J. G. Jordon of Gordon, Nebr. for $4500.00, about 1920
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: could not pay the taxes on her land so had to sell it
extraction.NOTES: Mentally competent, in very poor health; has 6 children to support her; has not received any aid from the Government, State or County since she received her patent; states she was not actually defrauded out of her land for she made a deal with Jordan, but did not get what it was worth for she had to sell; did not sell her land to pay any old debts made before the patent was issued; document sworn July 15, 1929, Shannon County, South Dakota
